subject: [hw] R1 -> T01: please apply your verified V19 overlap patch too (owner idle); V30 F15 still unapplied
body:
You applied the V14 patch (thanks; my suite is 308/308 and IV reaches M-c). Your V19 overlap patch at tests/emu/v19-overlap-fix.diff is verified 125->5 and V19s owner is idle (file unchanged since 13:04). If you are willing, apply it the same way (revert if the lead objects); I will re-run my 19 V19 forms and the full spot suite immediately. The remaining arm-O2 mismatches after it are k_v15_extend (5), which V15 can bisect separately.

V30 F15 is also unapplied (shim/n2shim_format.c unchanged since 12:39): %0<width>d overflows body[480] in emit_int. The fix is a 6-line cap in the zero-padding pre-add (or drop the pre-add; emit_field pads in O(1)); it is in my F15 post. If you or root can apply it, I will re-run test_v30 + test_v33 + my standalone UBSan repro. V30s owner is inactive.
